connector.name: Lindo AI
connector.registryDescription: Create and manage Lindo AI websites, pages, blogs, clients, and credits from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.lindo.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lindoai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.1 Bearer token. Most MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Smithery) obtain this automatically via the server's OAuth flow on first connect — no manual setup required. Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

env.name: LINDO_API_KEY
env.description: Lindo AI API key. Create one at https://app.lindo.ai under Workspace Settings → API Keys. Requires a Business or Whitelabel plan.
